arxiv-2005-07042.title: Differential equation for the flow rate of discharging silos based on energy balance
arxiv-2005-07042.creator: J. R. Darias 1 , Marcos A. Madrid 2,3 , Luis A. Pugnaloni 4
arxiv-2005-07042.description: Abstract Since the early work of Hagen in 1852 and Beverloo et al. in 1961, the flow rate of granular material discharging through a circular orifice from a silo has been described by means of dimensional analysis and experimental fits, and explained through the “free fall arch” model.

arxiv-2112-02022.title: Ephemeral Ice-Like Local Environments in Classical Rigid Models of Liquid Water
arxiv-2112-02022.creator: Riccardo Capelli, Francesco Muniz-Miranda, Giovanni M. Pavan
arxiv-2112-02022.description: Abstract Despite great efforts over the past 50 years, the simulation of water still presents significant challenges and open questions. At room temperature and pressure, the collective molecular interactions and dynamics of water molecules may form local structural arrangements that are non-trivial to classify.

arxiv-2204-09638.title: Factors Hindering the Adoption of DevOps in the Saudi Software Industry
arxiv-2204-09638.creator: Mamdouh Alenezi
arxiv-2204-09638.description: Abstract DevOps has gained high importance in the global software industry due to the ease of software development, testing and deployment it provides. However, the Saudi software industry has not been able to adopt DevOps at a great pace due to various factors.

arxiv-2405-04450.title: A natural model for curved inflation
arxiv-2405-04450.creator: Quentin Vigneron, Julien Larena
arxiv-2405-04450.description: Abstract Inflationary models with a non-zero background curvature require additional hypothesis or parameters compared to flat inflation and the procedure to construct them cannot be as simple as in the flat case. For this reason, there is no consensus on the primordial power spectrum that should be considered at large scales in a curved Universe.

arxiv-2406-11222.title: VIRTUALLY REGULAR MODULES
arxiv-2406-11222.creator: ENGİN Büyükaşık, Özlem Irmak Demir
arxiv-2406-11222.description: Abstract . We call a right module M M (strongly) virtually regular if every (finitely generated) cyclic submodule is isomorphic to a direct summand. M M is said to be completely virtually regular if every submodule is virtually regular. In this paper, characterizations and some closure properties of the aforementioned modules are given.

arxiv-2408-00392.title: Polynomial quasi-Trefftz DG for PDEs with smooth coefficients: elliptic problems
arxiv-2408-00392.creator: Lise-Marie Imbert-Gérard, Andrea Moiola, Chiara Perinati, Paul Stocker
arxiv-2408-00392.description: Abstract Trefftz schemes are high-order Galerkin methods whose discrete spaces are made of elementwise exact solutions of the underlying PDE. Trefftz basis functions can be easily computed for many PDEs that are linear, homogeneous, and have piecewise-constant coefficients. However, if the equation has variable coefficients, exact solutions are generally unavailable.

arxiv-2408-16445.title: Mismatched: Evaluating the Limits of Image Matching Approaches and Benchmarks
arxiv-2408-16445.creator: Sierra Bonilla, Chiara Di Vece *, Rema Daher *, Xinwei Ju *, Danail Stoyanov, Francisco Vasconcelos, Sophia Bano
arxiv-2408-16445.description: Abstract Three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction from two-dimensional images is an active research field in computer vision, with applications ranging from navigation and object tracking to segmentation and three-dimensional modeling. Traditionally, parametric techniques have been employed for this task. However, recent advancements have seen a shift towards learning-based methods.

arxiv-2409-10653.title: Logic Synthesis Optimization with Predictive Self-Supervision via Causal Transformers DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: The Design Automation Conference; June 22–25, 2025; San Francisco, CA ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Hardware Electronic design automation (EDA); Logic synthesis CCS: Computing
arxiv-2409-10653.creator: Raika Karimi, Faezeh Faez, Yingxue Zhang, Xing Li, Lei Chen, Mingxuan Yuan, Mahdi Biparva
arxiv-2409-10653.description: Abstract . Contemporary hardware design benefits from the abstraction provided by high-level logic gates, streamlining the implementation of logic circuits. Logic Synthesis Optimization (LSO) operates at one level of abstraction within the Electronic Design Automation (EDA) workflow, targeting improvements in logic circuits with respect to performance metrics such as size and speed in the final layout.

arxiv-2411-15323.title: Model-Based Iterative Reconstruction of Three-Dimensional Magnetisation in a Nanowire Structure Using Electron Holographic Vector Field Tomography
arxiv-2411-15323.creator: Aurys Šilinga \ORCID 0000-0001-6124-1754, András Kovács \ORCID 0000-0001-8485-991X, Stephen McVitie \ORCID 0000-0003-4511-6413, Rafal E. Dunin-Borkowski \ORCID 0000-0001-8082-0647, Kayla Fallon, Trevor P. Almeida \ORCID 0000-0003-4683-6279
arxiv-2411-15323.description: Abstract Experimental techniques for the characterisation of three-dimensional (3D) magnetic spin structures are required to advance the performance of nanoscale magnetic technologies. However, as component dimensions approach the nanometre range, it becomes ever more challenging to analyse 3D magnetic configurations quantitatively with the required spatial resolution and sensitivity.

arxiv-2505-06659.title: Structure Theorem for Quantum Replacer Codes
arxiv-2505-06659.creator: Eric Chitambar 1 , Sarah Hagen 2 , David W. Kribs 3 , Mike I. Nelson 4 , Andrew Nemec 5
arxiv-2505-06659.description: Abstract . Quantum replacer codes are codes that can be protected from errors induced by a given set of quantum replacer channels, an important class of quantum channels that includes the erasures of subsets of qubits that arise in quantum error correction.

arxiv-2512-16661.title: Microsoft Academic Graph Information Retrieval for Research Recommendation and Assistance
arxiv-2512-16661.creator: Shikshya Shiwakoti, Samuel Goldsmith, Ujjwal Pandit
arxiv-2512-16661.description: Abstract In today’s information world, access to scientific publications has never been easier. At the same time, filtering through the mega corpus of information for research has never been more difficult. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and graph attention mechanisms have proven very useful in searching through large databases of information, especially when paired with modern large language models.

arxiv-2602-16399.title: Multi-Channel Replay Speech Detection using Acoustic Maps Thanks:
arxiv-2602-16399.creator: Michael Neri , Tuomas Virtanen
arxiv-2602-16399.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Michael Neri , Tuomas Virtanen. Replay attacks remain a critical vulnerability for automatic speaker verification systems, particularly in real-time voice assistant applications. In this work, we propose acoustic maps as a novel spatial feature representation for replay speech detection from multi-channel recordings. Derived from classical beamforming over discrete azimuth and elevation grids, acoustic maps encode directional energy distributions that reflect physical differences between human speech radiation and loudspeaker-based replay.

arxiv-2605-12705.title: Early Data Exposure Improves Robustness to Subsequent Fine-Tuning

europmc-pmc5371998.creator: Musacchio A, Desai A.
europmc-pmc5371998.description: Kinetochores are large protein assemblies that connect chromosomes to microtubules of the mitotic and meiotic spindles in order to distribute the replicated genome from a mother cell to its daughters. Kinetochores also control feedback mechanisms responsible for the correction...

plos-pone-0010414.title: New Vaccine Design Based on Defective Genomes That Combines Features of Attenuated and Inactivated Vaccines
plos-pone-0010414.creator: Teresa Rodríguez-Calvo, Samuel Ojosnegros, Marta Sanz-Ramos et al.
plos-pone-0010414.description: PLOS ONE research article. New vaccine designs are needed to control diseases associated with antigenically variable RNA viruses. Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a highly contagious disease of livestock that inflicts severe economic losses. Although the current whole-virus chemically inactivated vaccine ha

pmc-11385867.title: Artificial intelligence and wheezing in children: where are we now?
pmc-11385867.creator: Laura Venditto, Sonia Morano, Michele Piazza, Marco Zaffanello, Laura Tenero, Giorgio Piacentini, Giuliana Ferrante
pmc-11385867.description: Wheezing is a common condition in childhood, and its prevalence has increased in the last decade. Up to one-third of preschoolers develop recurrent wheezing, significantly impacting their quality of life and healthcare resources. Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies have recently been applied in paediatric allergology and pulmonology, contributing to disease recognition, risk stratification, and decision support.

pmc-11551594.title: Role of nonpharmacological concussion management in children: systematic review of randomized controlled trials
pmc-11551594.creator: Andre Marolop Pangihutan Siahaan, Alvin Ivander, Rr Suzy Indharty, Steven Tandean, Anastasia Grace Milenia Ginting, Masrini Ginting, Felix Khosasi, Elbert
pmc-11551594.description: Concussion is a global public health problem that affects many children worldwide. Most patients present with postconcussion syndrome and normal brain imaging findings. Despite the high incidence of concussion in children, published research on nonpharmacological management is lacking and much more often concerns pharmacological interventions.

pmc-11677111.title: Bacterial Diversity in the Different Ecological Niches Related to the Yonghwasil Pond (Republic of Korea)
pmc-11677111.creator: Myung Kyum Kim, Bong-Soon Lim, Chang Seok Lee, Sathiyaraj Srinivasan, Adam Solti, Edina Simon
pmc-11677111.description: The bacteriome profile was studied in freshwater ecosystems within the Yonghwasil pond, situated at the National Institute of Ecology, Seocheon-gun, Chungcheongnam-do, central western Korea. Six samples from water, mud, and soil niches were assessed, specifically from lake water, bottom mud (sediment), and root-soil samples of Bulrush, wild rice, Reed, and Korean Willow.

pmc-12655673.title: DHN-YOLO: A Joint Detection Algorithm for Strawberries at Different Maturity Stages and Key Harvesting Points
pmc-12655673.creator: Hongrui Hao, Juan Xi, Jingyuan Dai, Guozheng Wang, Dayang Liu, Liangkuan Zhu, Vittorio Rossi
pmc-12655673.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Strawberries are important cash crops. Traditional manual picking is costly and inefficient, while automated harvesting robots are hindered by field challenges like stem-leaf occlusion, fruit overlap, and appearance/maturity variations from lighting and viewing angles. To address the need for accurate cross-maturity fruit identification and keypoint detection, this study constructed a strawberry image dataset covering multiple varieties, ripening stages, and complex ridge-cultivation field conditions: MSRBerry.

pmc-13048852.title: Organ preservation with total neoadjuvant therapy in early‐stage rectal cancer: A statewide analysis
pmc-13048852.creator: Zachary Bunjo, Tracy Fitzsimmons, Thuy‐My Nguyen, Michael Penniment, Sudarshan Selva‐Nayagam, Darren Tonkin, Tiong Cheng Sia, Elizabeth Murphy, Michelle Thomas, Tarik Sammour
pmc-13048852.description: BackgroundThe standard treatment for early‐stage (cT2‐3N0) rectal adenocarcinoma is upfront Total Mesorectal Excision (TME), but the desire for organ preservation has seen the increasing use of neoadjuvant therapy in these patients. Owing to its likely higher complete response rate, Total Neoadjuvant Therapy (TNT) is an attractive but understudied option.

pmc-13068519.title: Sustainable materials selection with emerging structural materials
pmc-13068519.creator: Sam Burdett, Mohit Arora, Rupert J. Myers
pmc-13068519.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The construction industry is rapidly changing to meet growing demand and reduce its environmental impact. These objectives can be met, in part, through improved selection of construction materials. However, the material properties including embodied carbon (EC) of emerging construction materials are less well documented in material property databases compared to conventional ones, providing barriers to their utilisation and correct perception of their decarbonisation potentials.

pmc-13188147.title: Think. Build. Heal. Also, tell the story.
pmc-13188147.creator: Jamaji C Nwanaji-Enwerem, Emily Pentzer, Mariel S Lavieri, Kiana Aran, Sabrina A Assoumou, Eri Saikawa, Ying Zhang, Melanie D Napier, John Reich, Amanda Vernon, Rachel Gallery, Mitul Luhar, Lisa S Rotenstein, Ayodeji Coker, Karma Sawyer, Jim Yoon, Jessica Menold
pmc-13188147.description: night. Maybe it was while building a volcano in grade school, volunteering at a nature center, or seeing a loved one's life transformed by a new treatment. Maybe it was not a single moment, but rather a gradual pathway with a series of experiences.

pmc-13277139.title: Enfortumab vedotin in ECOG-PS 2 advanced urothelial carcinoma patients: a real-world study from the ARON-2EV project
pmc-13277139.creator: Alessandro Rizzo, Francesco Ciccimarra, Stenio de Casio Zequi, Samantha Bove, Maria Colomba Comes, Ondřej Fiala, Akihiro Yano, Kirstin Binz, Ray Manneh Kopp, Jawaher Ansari, Renate Pichler, Oronzo Brunetti, Daniele Santini, Alina Pirstuk, Annarita Fanizzi, Gerardo Cazzato, Mario Della Mura, Mobin Sa
pmc-13277139.description: BackgroundEnfortumab vedotin (EV) is approved for the treatment of metastatic urothelial carcinoma (mUC), as monotherapy or in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), following the results of recent practice-changing clinical trials, such as EV-301 and EV-302. However, EV-301 included only patients with Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group Performance Status (ECOG-PS) 0 or 1, while ECOG-PS 2 mUC patients were excluded.

pmc-13415872.title: Association between METS-VF and hypertension in U.S.: a cross-sectional analysis of NHANES data
pmc-13415872.creator: Zhen Guo, Ziyu Zhang, Yulin Tian, Xia Guo, Hanchi Xu, Haoxuan Chu, Shipeng Wang, Lu Gao, Yushi Wang
pmc-13415872.description: Visceral fat accumulation is a key factor in the onset of cardiometabolic diseases, including hypertension. Metabolic Score for Visceral Fat (METS-VF) is an innovative, non-invasive metric developed to estimate visceral fat based on commonly accessible clinical parameters. A total of 13,822 participants were included in this cross-sectional analysis.

pmc-13556889.title: 635. Immunological characteristics of patients with schizophrenia and various degrees of severity of neurocognitive disorders
pmc-13556889.creator: O Lobacheva, V Nikitina, D Petkun, T Popova, E Kornetova, N Bokhan
pmc-13556889.description: BackgroundNeurocognitive deficits in schizophrenia are a significant factor in the poor prognosis of the disease and contribute significantly to social maladjustment and disability. The pathophysiological mechanisms underlying cognitive dysfunction in schizophrenia remain unclear. The brain and the peripheral immune system are in constant interaction, mediated by cytokines. Microglia are a key factor in the pathogenesis of brain diseases.
